semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging and automatic testing equipment.
summary: Jiaxing Jingyan Intelligent Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced semiconductor packaging and testing equipment, including die bonders and inspection machines. With a strong R&D team and a focus on high-performance, cost-effective solutions, they aim to enhance customer investment value in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a 15,000-square-meter factory in Jiaxing, China, which includes specialized workshops for assembly and manufacturing.
